purpose: Standardize the executable boundary from a pre-specified pilot task set to administered task instances, immutable raw observations and a reproducible execution export.
registration_rules: A task instance may reference only a task present in the pre-specified pilot task set.
Each task instance has an explicit learner, study, session, wave, registry version, variation, prompt, instruction-exposure, technical-quality and administration timestamp context.
Task-instance IDs are unique within an execution dataset; deterministic IDs may be generated when an explicit ID is not supplied.
A raw observation must reference exactly one registered task instance.
Observation identity fields must agree with the registered task instance before the observation enters the dataset.
Raw observations are validated without adding inferred mastery, developmental position, prerequisite status, causal inference, curriculum promotion or next-action fields.
export_rules: Execution export validates the complete dataset boundary before export.
Export ordering is deterministic and does not mutate source records.
The export preserves one explicit provenance class (synthetic_fixture or empirical) and one study, wave and registry-version context for the exported dataset.
C3 coding records remain separate from raw observations and are not generated by the execution layer.
A validated execution export is an auditable research input, not a mastery store or developmental conclusion.

supabase.reason: The execution boundary is implemented as a pure deterministic engine layer first; persistence is added only when the actual pilot runtime contract requires it.

scientific_boundary: Successful registration or export proves structural execution integrity only; it does not establish reliability, developmental ordering, prerequisite status, mastery or curriculum promotion.
